caption: The drawing depicts an oil lamp composed of several distinct parts. At the top, there is a tall, transparent glass chimney with a slightly flared opening, and beneath it is a brass-colored burner with metallic fixtures. The middle section is a textured, cylindrical reservoir made of a bluish-gray material with a diamond-patterned surface. Below the reservoir, the lamp has a gold-colored, turned column stem that widens at the base. The entire lamp stands on a square base that is rendered in a light brown color. The objects are centrally aligned on a light beige or off-white background.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
